who: A veterinary nurse on shifts. Plays bass in a band that has one gig booked, and is moving flat.

moments.plot: The move is in eight days and the gig is the night before.

tasks.title: Collect banana boxes from the market
tasks.notes: After two, when they close. Ask for the ones with lids.

tasks.title: Ask Dev about the van again
tasks.notes: It is the band van, so it smells of the band van. Bring blankets.

tasks.title: Photograph the meter and the walls
Forward the post from the old address

capture.title: Ask Siobhan for her tape gun

file.title: Does the sofa fit round the stairs?
file.notes: Measure the landing, not the door. The door is not the problem.

dated.title: Pack the records
dated.notes: Small boxes. Dev carried the last lot and still mentions it.

repeating.title: Feed the clinic fish
repeating.notes: One pinch. The blue one pretends.

attachments.notes: Every wall, with the date. The mark behind the sofa was there before us. Siobhan says take one of the oven too.

tasks.title: Practice at Dev’s, bring the pedal

agent.title: List everyone who needs the new address
agent.notes: Start from the folder of letters. Leave out the ones that are only adverts.
agent.question: Should I write the messages as well?
bodies: Fourteen places need the new address. Five want it before you move: the bank, the insurance, the register, the clinic and the bass insurance.
Fourteen places need the new address. Nine can get the same short message, drafted below. Five have their own form.
agent.otherBody: Fourteen places need the new address, and five want it before you move. Your direction: {answer}
agent.otherAnswer: Only for the five urgent ones
agent.acceptance: Everyone who needs the address is on the list.

discuss.title: Tell the landlady about the shelf
discuss.notes: We put it up without asking. It is a good shelf.
discuss.question: What would you like to suggest?
options: Leave it for the next person
Take it and fill the holes
bodies: Hello, we put up a shelf in the kitchen and should have asked first. It is solid and level, and we would be happy to leave it.
Hello, we put up a shelf in the kitchen and should have asked first. We will take it with us, fill the holes and paint over them.
discuss.otherBody: Hello, we put up a shelf in the kitchen and should have asked first. {answer}
discuss.otherAnswer: We’ll fill the holes and paint over them

review.title: List everyone who needs the new address
review.note: Fourteen places. Two letters had no name on them, so I left them out.

review.title: Type up the handover sheet
review.note: One side of A4. I could not read the dose for the cat in bay 3.
